fusions.name: Robbing the Comb
fusions.desc: A sting that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. 25% of the damage it deals comes back to you as healing over the following 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Left-Behind Barb
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A sting that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Rally Scent
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Never Idle Wings
fusions.desc: Each time you kill an enemy, 3 stamina a second comes back to you for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
